 # Architecture
 
+## Canonical ordinary paint coverage
+
+`engine/paint-coverage.ts` owns raw untextured brush/pencil/eraser/clone coverage and fill geometry. Complete contributing native primitives replay into canonical 256-pixel cells with a support halo and an eight-pixel gradient phase. Rebasing preserves source coordinates at large translations. Scratch allocation stays within 4 MP/8192 edges; larger projected primitives use `primitive-coverage.ts` pixel-area integration and `paint-premultiplied.ts` destination-byte composition, without shrinking authored geometry. Proven solid strips at unit flow can overwrite exact opaque RGB; all uncertain edges keep integration. Soft coverage bounds bypass integration only when every possible value produces identical stored bytes.
+
+`ActiveStrokeRaster` retains at most a 16 MiB raw viewport, independently owns mutable accepted points and stages numerical extensions privately. Superseded/cancelled work cannot install a partial prefix. Native padding has its own bounded allocation; `PaintedMaskRaster` reserves both viewport and padding bytes in its shared 16 MiB LRU, recalculating reservations when an existing key grows. Numerical replay shares a two-millisecond task deadline across primitives and pixel blocks, including accelerated opaque stamps. Clip/whole-stroke opacity apply once after raw coverage.
+
+This corrects crop-sensitive antialiasing, so some edge pixels differ from older replay. Authored samples, original assets, OO commands/history, schema 37/project 3/workspace 2 and isolated scripting/REST boundaries remain unchanged. Textured/wet coverage, broader backend/device fidelity and sustained/process-memory performance retain their separate acceptance requirements. Current verification is recorded in the implementation roadmap.
+
+Inverse-scaled integral crop positions recover their exact lattice indices before native cell selection and numerical dither, without snapping authored geometry. Native vector masks share this index helper. Cache invalidation controls retention separately from explicit caller cancellation: a direct mask read must survive a viewport cache reset. Busy active-mask entries have exclusive producer leases; concurrent readers replay privately, and retired entries dispose their surfaces after the current lease ends.
+
 ## Native frequency workflow controls — schema 37, functionally verified
 
 GroupLayerData.frequencyRadius is an optional finite shared radius. LayerGroup exposes its OO setter; Layer.frequencyGroup locates the nearest controller. Attached updates use ordinary strict layer.update validation/locks/history. The smart resolver derives frequency-filter sigma in a private render tree while descending groups, and resets inherited scope when entering a component master. Source DTOs, individual fallbacks and locked correction children are not mutated. Capture the effective scope when isolating, converting, rasterizing or copying artwork into another document plane; Photoshop plane/prefix planning does likewise. Legacy groups remain independent.

+### 2026-10-20 — F06/F14 canonical ordinary paint, cache ownership and task budgets verified
+
+Owner: implementation engineer; estimate: measured rendering correction. The preceding commit-only turn verified the existing clean checkpoint without advancing implementation. This continuation preserves the complete original roadmap objective. Ordinary untextured brush/pencil/eraser/clone coverage and fills now retain complete primitives on a canonical native grid; oversized projected geometry uses bounded numerical coverage rather than source resizing. Exact inverse-scale indices preserve fractional-zoom crop pixels, including native vector masks. Raw accumulation precedes selection and whole-stroke opacity. Mutable accepted points are owned; numerical extensions stage privately and share one task deadline across accelerated stamps and pixel blocks. Source bytes/geometry, OO commands/history, isolation and schema 37/project 3/workspace 2 remain unchanged.
+
+Actual regressions were reproduced and corrected before acceptance: stale mutable native prefixes; 53,747,840 retained padding bytes reported as 128; maximum-size pencil-mask p95 of 102.5 ms versus 7.6 ms on the frozen release; and a 431 ms accelerated-stamp task. The mask LRU now reserves viewport plus padding bytes and handles growing keys. Certified opaque regions preserve exact stored bytes; 24 alternating numerical comparisons are retained from that optimization phase. The first main native matrix passed 226 cases and failed one direct feathered-mask read. Twenty fresh pages reproduced implicit cancellation on retention-epoch changes. Retention eligibility now stays separate from explicit caller cancellation; busy producers hold exclusive leases, independent readers replay privately and retired owners dispose after release. Non-binary zoom probes also exposed RGB phase mismatches; inverse-index normalization corrects them without snapping authored geometry.
+
+The final main build, all 1,400 unit/API cases in 173 files, all 231 affected native browser cases and all 84 normal-production workflows pass without accepted skips, retries or flakes. Coverage includes the original feathered-mask regression, 15 focused paint cases, 19 pure numerical/lattice cases, real 50 MP source/save/reopen/full output, SVG/native interchange and actual software-WGSL behavior. Forced cache retirement, simultaneous readers, explicit cancellation, source precision, whole/incremental/cropped pixels and observed owned-buffer budgets are verified. Test-only tilt fields, optional-result narrowing, missing mock rect/clip methods, an absent eraser foreground control and a prototype hook that did not reach the served module instance are retained as excluded setup failures, separately from the real regressions and failed matrix.
+
+Three clean alternating public-only production pairs cover nine ordinary tool/target combinations and three maximum-size leading-edge fixtures. They retain 1,440 newly matching pointer movements, 72 native long-task controls, 216 complete PNGs and 216 independently decoded projects. Every stroke preserves all 21 exact x/y points, one intended operation and exact model/pixel undo. Candidate median per-run p95 ranges from 2.2 to 23.1 ms; every candidate run remains below 33 ms, with a maximum per-run p95 of 23.6 ms and no overlapping gesture long task. All twelve medians are higher than the former crop-sensitive renderer. Earlier cold replay is also slower in measured fixtures. Adoption corrects rendering/ownership/scheduling; no general speedup, sustained/editor-wide or physical-display acceptance is claimed.
+
+Independent Pillow/NumPy checks verify all 216 PNGs, all known input pixels, complete undo and identical initial artwork across releases. Ten of twelve fixture appearances match the old renderer exactly. The maximum-size hard circle changes 130 edge pixels by up to 37 alpha bytes; the filter-mask eraser changes 132 RGB pixels by up to ten bytes with alpha unchanged. An independent 32,768-subrow area integral matches every alpha pixel in all three new circle frames exactly, versus a 37-byte maximum difference in the old frames. This is one geometric fixture, not broad portrait/backend/device quality acceptance. Authored strokes retain their data, but legacy antialiased edge pixels can render differently.
+
+[Sealed coverage evidence](benchmarks/brush-crop-coverage-2026-10-20.json) retains source/release identities, reconstructable deltas, failed variants, complete raw reports and input artifacts. All 35 previous benchmark artifacts remain unchanged. Textured/wet crop invariance, roughly 35-second full-frame frequency retouch export, portrait quality, sustained/editor-wide latency, physical/tablet/display behavior, process memory and every other unfinished professional, AI/provider, workflow and commercial requirement remain active. This increment does not complete or redefine the full original goal.  # Canoli Studio editor requirements
+
+## Ordinary paint crop consistency
+
+Untextured brush, pencil, eraser and clone coverage, fills, ordinary masks and filter masks must retain exact pixels across crops on the same output-pixel lattice and between cold/incremental replay. Preserve complete authored geometry when projected footprints exceed scratch budgets; do not cap or downsample source geometry. Numerical work must yield across long runs of accelerated stamps, reject superseded/resized presentation, own mutable accepted input and keep cancelled extensions private. Mask cache budgets include retained native padding and changing reservations at existing keys.
+
+Verify exact affine/scale/seam pixels, real oversized edits, source-coordinate precision, mutable-prefix invalidation, cancellation/input responsiveness and observed owned Canvas allocations. Existing source/history/project, 50 MP, export and supported-GPU tests remain required. Canonical antialiasing can change edge pixels relative to the former crop-sensitive renderer without changing authored data or persistent formats. Textured/wet crop stability, representative quality, sustained/editor-wide latency, hardware/tablet and process-memory acceptance remain open.
+
+Include non-binary fractional zooms and numerical/native vector coverage in lattice tests. Cache resets must not cancel independent direct mask reads; simultaneous readers at the same cache key retain their own exact results, and retiring an in-flight owner releases its buffers after the current read completes. Explicit caller cancellation remains authoritative.
 
 ## F05 live frequency preview and shared controls — functionally verified

 # Canoli Studio System Design & Architecture Specification
+
+## Ordinary paint crop and retained-buffer invariant
+
+Untextured coverage on the same output-pixel lattice must be independent of viewport/export crop boundaries. Canonical native cells retain complete contributing primitives; oversized projected geometry uses bounded numerical pixel coverage. Preserve original sample indices, pressure, tilt, copy order and source geometry. Apply selection and whole-stroke opacity after raw stamp accumulation. Opaque shortcuts require certified complete pixels and identical destination bytes, rather than approximate edge coverage.
+
+Accepted active prefixes own mutable inputs. Yielded extensions stay private until current-generation publication; cancellation preserves a reusable accepted prefix and releases failed stages. One task deadline spans consecutive numerical primitives as well as pixel blocks. Every retained native padding surface counts toward the mask LRU alongside the raw viewport, including size changes at an existing key. Working-surface budgets never become authored image or geometry limits. Logical owned-buffer checks do not establish browser process-memory or physical-display acceptance.
+
+Normalize lattice indices only when an integral projected coordinate round-trips exactly through its inverse scale; preserve genuinely fractional origins. Retention epochs do not cancel independent reads. A busy mask-cache producer owns an exclusive lease: a second reader uses private work, and eviction/cache clearing retires the owner until its lease releases. Explicit caller cancellation still stops work and prevents partial publication.
